about_the_game:
One day, while tracing old folklore, I heard an intriguing rumor.

“On the outskirts of the Higashiyama region, in the village of Mikagura, there is said to be a shrine maiden possessed by an evil spirit.”

It sounded like a ridiculous story, but I decided to go to the village to find out if it was true.

Mikagura Village—

A remote mountain village not even properly marked on maps.

Cell phone signals were intermittent, and the village was shrouded in a silence that felt as though time had stopped.

Without any guidance, I arrived at a dilapidated shrine on the outskirts of the village.

Deep within the shrine, which had not been maintained for years, beyond a door sealed shut like a seal—

I encountered a shrine maiden.

About this game

• This is a choice-based adventure game where you perform an exorcism on a shrine maiden possessed by an evil spirit through torture.

• Players use options such as dumplings, whips, and nails to attack the evil spirit. If the attack hits the evil spirit, its HP decreases; if it hits the shrine maiden, her HP decreases.

• The game is cleared when the demon's HP reaches 0. If the shrine maiden's HP reaches 0, the game ends.

• As days pass, the demon's HP increases.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains the following elements.

Comic violence/fantasy violence

Combat without gore or blood; weapon display; bones/skeletons; derogatory language; suffering
Realistic violence

Blood; violent acts; accidental death; bodily injury; corpses; descriptions of violence

Killing

Extremely violent or contains gore (e.g., dismemberment, torture, detailed depictions of death, etc.)

Glorification/incitement of violence

Realistic excessive/unjustified violence, grotesque violence

Horror—the setting is dark but not realistic

Extremely frightening scenes; psychological horror
